import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"
import { ORGANIZER } from "./support/accounts"
import { openEventList, signIn } from "./support/auth"

test("captures the long program copy dialog", async ({ page }) => {
  const viewport = page.viewportSize()
  if (!viewport) throw new Error("Set the screenshot viewport in the runner")
  const shotPath = process.env.SHOT_PATH
  if (!shotPath) throw new Error("Set SHOT_PATH to the screenshot output file")

  // Navigate through the desktop event tabs before restoring the requested viewport.
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 800 })
  await signIn(page, "organizer", ORGANIZER)
  await openEventList(page)
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: /Letní kemp 2027(?! – demo)/ }).click()
  await page
    .getByRole("navigation", { name: "Event sections" })
    .getByRole("link", { name: "Program" })
    .click()
  await page.setViewportSize(viewport)

  if (!(await page.getByRole("button", { name: /Show details of Forest orientation/ }).isVisible())) {
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Add block", exact: true }).click()
  const editor = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Add block" })
  await editor.getByLabel("Block name").fill("Forest orientation")
  await editor
    .getByLabel("Description")
    .fill(
      ("Bring water and comfortable shoes. Meet by the main gate. " +
        "We will practise reading the map and follow the marked trail. ").repeat(8).trim(),
    )
  await editor.getByRole("button", { name: "Add block" }).click()
  await expect(editor).toBeHidden()
  }

  await page.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Term", exact: true }).click()
  await page.getByRole("option").last().click()
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Copy program", exact: true }).click()
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Copy program" })
  await dialog.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Source term" }).click()
  await page.getByRole("option").first().click()
  await expect(dialog.getByText("Forest orientation", { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible()
  await expect(dialog.getByRole("button", { name: /^Copy \d+ blocks?$/ })).toBeEnabled()
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle")
  await page.screenshot({ path: process.env.SHOT_PATH!, fullPage: false })
})

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"
import { ORGANIZER, MANUAL_EVENT_LINK } from "./support/accounts"
import { openEventList, signIn } from "./support/auth"

test("Selected applications and available bulk actions", async ({ page }) => {
  const target = page.viewportSize()!
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 800 })
  const people = target.width === 360 ? [["Lenka", "Novotná"], ["Irena", "Malá"]] : [["Tereza","Nová"], ["Petra","Krátká"]]
  for (const [first, last] of people) {
    await page.goto(MANUAL_EVENT_LINK)
    await page.getByLabel("First name").fill(first)
    await page.getByLabel("Last name").fill(last)
    await page.getByLabel("Date of birth").fill("03/09/2013")
    await page.getByLabel("Gender").click()
    await page.getByRole("option", { name: "Woman", exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("group", { name: /Choose at least one term/ }).getByRole("checkbox").first().check()
    await page.getByLabel("Contact e-mail").fill(first.toLowerCase() + "-preview@example.com")
    await page.getByLabel(/I agree to the processing/).check()
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Continue to review" }).click()
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Submit application" }).click()
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/apply\/confirmation\//)
  }
  await signIn(page, "organizer", ORGANIZER)
  await openEventList(page)
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: /Ruční vyhodnocení 2028/ }).click()
  await page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Event sections" }).getByRole("link", {name:"Applications"}).click()
  await page.getByRole("radio", { name: "Awaiting evaluation" }).click()
  await page.setViewportSize(target)
  for (const who of people.map(pair => pair.join(" "))) {
    const box = page.getByRole("checkbox", {name:"Select application: "+who})
    await box.click()
    await expect(box).toBeChecked()
  }
  const status = page.getByRole("status").filter({hasText:/^2 applications$/})
  await expect(status).toBeVisible()
  await status.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  await page.mouse.move(0,0)
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle")
  await page.screenshot({path:process.env.SHOT_PATH!,fullPage:false})
})
